criteria.short: Correct matching of all six sentence parts (1f, 2d, 3e, 4c, 5b, 6a)
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling ordnet alle Satzteile korrekt zu:
bullets: 1 – f) the school is collecting money for charity.
3 – e) he doesn't want to sell his things.
4 – c) she brings his old things to the flea market.
5 – b) he hopes he's lucky and gets a prize.
6 – a) he gets a new bike!

criteria.short: Four sentences in correct simple present word order
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling bildet vier Sätze in korrekter Simple-present-Wortstellung, z. B.:
bullets: Luke often meets his friends at the Cutty Sark on Saturdays.
Holly always takes photos in Greenwich Park in the morning.
The friends sometimes buy fresh fruit at Greenwich Market after school.
Olivia never plays her saxophone at the Royal Observatory in the evening.
schema: Je Satz (1,5 P.): 0,5 P. Satzstellung (Adverb/Zeitangabe korrekt platziert) + 0,5 P. sprachliche Richtigkeit + 0,5 P. **3rd person -s**

criteria.short: Four correct wh-questions in the simple present
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling bildet vier korrekte Fragen im Simple present, z. B.:
bullets: What does Mr Swindon teach on Mondays?
When does Holly feed her guinea pigs?
Why do your friends love Greenwich Park?
schema: Je Frage (1,5 P.): 0,5 P. Fragewortstellung (question word + **do/does** + Subjekt + Verb) + 0,5 P. sprachliche Richtigkeit + 0,5 P. korrekte 3rd-person-Form (**does**)

sections.titel: 3 What is happening in Greenwich Park?

criteria.short: Six present progressive sentences describing the picture's actions
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling beschreibt sechs Handlungen im Present progressive, z. B.:
bullets: A boy is playing the guitar.
A man is talking on the phone.
A woman is lying/relaxing on the blanket.
schema: Je Satz (1 P.): 0,5 P. korrekte **Present-progressive-Form** (be + -ing) + 0,5 P. sprachliche Richtigkeit/Bildbezug

criteria.intro: Der Prüfling verneint vier nicht gezeigte Handlungen im Present progressive, z. B.:
bullets: The man isn't reading a book.
schema: Je Satz (1,5 P.): 1 P. korrekte verneinte **Present-progressive-Form** + 0,5 P. sprachliche Richtigkeit
